title: LLM Wiki knowledge bundle v1
description: The strict persisted contract for llm-wiki-knowledge/v1. Unknown record fields are rejected. Implementations may carry forward custom data only inside an explicit extensions object whose keys are qualified as namespace/name. This platform-portable wire shape is native/private data, not a public-safe redacted projection. This artifact records observation bases; it never stores a timeless freshness verdict. Freshness is computed by consumers against live evaluated inputs.

concepts.description: Semantically unordered concept records. Canonical payloads order them by locator.

relationships.description: Semantically unordered relationship records. Canonical payloads order them by compact canonical JSON of each complete normalized record.

utf8String.description: A Unicode scalar-value string that can be encoded as strict UTF-8.

utf8JsonValue.description: A JSON value whose object keys and string values contain only Unicode scalar values.

qualifiedName.description: A custom name qualified by its owner as namespace/name.

extensions.description: Namespaced extension values. Values may be any JSON value; unqualified extension keys are forbidden.

hash.description: A SHA-256 digest over the bytes or normalized observation named by the containing field.

normalizedNonemptyString.description: A non-empty string without surrounding whitespace or embedded control characters.

linkObservationString.description: A lossless or normalized link target without credential-bearing URI authority userinfo, including after Markdown angle-destination normalization. Mail addresses and ordinary @ characters outside a URI authority remain valid.

limitationCode.description: A lowercase stable machine code, optionally qualified by one lowercase namespace.

repositoryIdentity.description: The literal unknown or a normalized configured/VCS namespace path with a lowercase leading namespace/host. Schemes, credentials, queries, fragments, checkout paths, opaque checkout hashes, and trailing .git suffixes are forbidden. The application-owned envelope builder records selection provenance in llm-wiki/identity-source.

evaluatedRevision.description: The literal unknown or the full lowercase Git object ID evaluated by the producer. Branch names, abbreviations, paths, and timestamps are forbidden.

repositoryRelativePath.description: A normalized, non-empty, repository-relative POSIX path. Absolute paths, Windows separators, empty segments, and dot segments are forbidden.

locator.description: A normalized LLM Wiki concept or document locator with a non-empty authority and no credentials, port, query, fragment, backslash, malformed percent escape, raw dot segment, or encoded slash. The Python parser additionally performs URI authority parsing and rejects unsafe segments after percent-decoding.

conceptKind.description: A built-in domain or document-only concept kind, or a namespaced custom kind.

relationshipKind.description: A built-in relationship kind, or a namespaced custom kind.

linkLocation.description: The half-open character range occupied by the observed Markdown link. The Python validator additionally requires end to be greater than start.

computedFreshness.description: Consumer-computed freshness vocabulary. It is intentionally not referenced by any persisted bundle property.

knowledgeLoadState.description: Consumer load-result vocabulary. It is intentionally not referenced by any persisted bundle property.

knowledgeProjectionProfile.description: Out-of-band redaction policy vocabulary. Artifact metadata never selects a profile, and this definition is intentionally not referenced by a persisted property.

repositoryIdentitySource.description: How an application-owned producer selected repository identity. This is redaction provenance, not attestation or access-control state.

analyzerComponent.description: An extractor or plugin whose safe effective configuration basis must be known or explicitly limited.

extractors.description: Semantically unordered extractor components. Canonical payloads order them by component id.

plugins.description: Semantically unordered plugin components. Canonical payloads order them by component id.

page_id.description: A safe canonical page identifier matching the surface registry.

canonical_path.description: A normalized repository-relative canonical Markdown path.

external_uri.description: An absolute URI outside the llm-wiki scheme and without credential-bearing authority userinfo.

raw_target.description: The lossless target spelling observed in source Markdown.

normalized_target.description: The collector's normalized target spelling, which may be empty for malformed input.

label.description: The lossless Markdown link or image label.
